answer_1.quote: Image captioning aims to automatically generate natural language sentences to describe image contents.

answer_2.quote: InfoMetIC achieves state-of-the-art correlation with human judgments on multiple benchmarks.

answer_4.quote: We collect a fine-grained caption evaluation benchmark called CapTokenEval... annotators are asked to judge which words are irrelevant with the image. For the image part, we collect 20 bounding boxes and ask annotators to identify mentioned regions. We invite 20 college students as annotators... Each annotator is assigned 35 image-caption pairs for annotation.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators judge which textual tokens are incorrect (irrelevant) and which image regions are mentioned by the caption.
